# MAG Beverages

> MAG Beverages makes the Spirited Kava Infuser bottle, Spirited Kava Shot, and the ready-to-drink Kava Cola and Kava Paloma cans — premium functional non-alcoholic drinks combining noble kava extract, ashwagandha, L-theanine, and Vitamin C. No THC, no CBD, no kratom. Third-party tested. Wholesale available nationwide — order direct at https://magbeverages.com/wholesale or through the Airgoods marketplace.

MAG Beverages is based in St. Louis, MO and was founded in 2024. Products are stocked at NA bars, bottle shops, smoke shops, and wellness retailers across the United States.

## Products

- **Spirited Kava Infuser** (756ml bottle) — Noble kava extract, ashwagandha, L-theanine, Vitamin C. Best seller. Available wholesale.
- **Spirited Kava Shot** (2oz shot) — Same functional stack in a grab-and-go format. Available wholesale.
- **Kava Cola** (16 fl oz / 474 ml can) — Ready-to-drink. 500 mg kava root extract, 60 mg organic caffeine, terpene essential oils. Blackberry cola flavor, zero sugar, zero calories. Available wholesale.
- **Kava Paloma** (16 fl oz / 474 ml can) — Ready-to-drink. 500 mg kava root extract, 30 mg organic caffeine, terpene essential oils. Grapefruit and real organic lime, zero sugar, zero calories. Available wholesale.
